question: Indian boxer Nishant Dev secured his second professional win against which opponent in a Super Welterweight bout at Madison Square Garden Theatre, New York in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Josue Silva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian pugilist **Nishant Dev** registered a significant victory in his professional boxing career by defeating **Josue Silva** in a high-stakes encounter.
 
• The bout took place in **June 2025** at the prestigious **Madison Square Garden Theatre** in **New York**, marking a major milestone for Indian professional boxing on the global stage.
 
• This victory secured **Nishant Dev's** **second professional win**, maintaining his undefeated streak since transitioning from the amateur circuit to the professional ranks.
 
• The match was contested in the **Super Welterweight** division, where **Nishant Dev** showcased his superior technical skills and punching power against his opponent.
 
• The win at such an iconic venue as **Madison Square Garden** significantly boosts **Nishant Dev's** world rankings and visibility in the **United States** boxing market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nishant Dev:**
 
 
• He hails from **Karnal**, **Haryana**, **India**, a region known for producing world-class boxers.
 
• Before turning professional, he achieved international acclaim by winning a **bronze medal** at the **2023 IBA Men’s World Boxing Championships** held in **Tashkent**.
 
• He represented **India** at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, reaching the **quarterfinals** in the **71 kg** category before making his professional debut in early **2025**.
 
 
 
• **Super Welterweight Division:**
 
 
• In professional boxing, the **Super Welterweight** category (also known as **Junior Middleweight** or **Light Middleweight**) has a weight limit of **154 pounds** (**69.9 kg**).
 
• It is one of the most competitive divisions in boxing, historically featuring legends like **Floyd Mayweather** and **Manny Pacquiao**.
 
 
 
• **Venue Significance:**
 
 
• **Madison Square Garden (MSG)** is often referred to as the "**Mecca of Boxing**." Hosting a bout at the **Theatre at MSG** is considered a rite of passage for rising stars in the professional boxing world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Professional vs. Amateur Boxing:** Professional boxing differs from the amateur style (seen in the Olympics) by the **absence of headgear**, the use of **smaller gloves**, and **longer durations** (ranging from **4 to 12 rounds**).
 
• **Transition to Pro:** **Nishant Dev's** move to the professional circuit follows a growing trend of elite Indian boxers, such as **Vijender Singh**, seeking global titles and commercial success outside the traditional amateur framework.
 
• **Record:** With this win against **Josue Silva**, **Nishant Dev** moves to a **2-0** professional record, establishing himself as a serious contender in the **Super Welterweight** class for **2025**.
